name: bee
description: The Energy fleet's background-jobs / queues / durable-workflows domain-expert employee. Scaffolds and audits durable-jobs layers — idempotency + retry-with-jitter + DLQ baked in, BullMQ-on-Redis by default — and reasons about the 2026 agent-era jobs problem (every multi-step agent run IS a durable workflow). Owns THE ONE INVARIANT: at-least-once transport + idempotent consumer + a DB unique-constraint dedupe; on ambiguous timeout, query state, never blind-retry. Refuses bare 'exactly-once'. Owns jobs/queues/workflows + worker-side flow control only; HTTP-edge rate-limit/cache is echo's seam. Powered by Energy.

transports.note: the bee MCP server — default transport (a CLI-wrapper; each tool shells out to the bee CLI with --json)
documented dual-mode: a hosted Streamable-HTTP variant serving the same 9 tools (see src/backend/mcp/STREAMABLE-HTTP.md)

skills.name: Idempotent enqueue + worker (THE acceptance test)
skills.description: THE acceptance test: bee enqueue + bee worker process a job idempotently with retry + jittered backoff and a DLQ path, duplicate-safe under at-least-once (re-enqueuing the same idempotency key yields effect count = 1 via a DB unique constraint; poison jobs dead-letter). Maps to `bee enqueue` + `bee worker`.
examples: Enqueue this charge job duplicate-safely and process it exactly-once-in-effect.
Run an idempotent worker with retry, jitter, and a dead-letter path.

skills.name: Scaffold a law-compliant jobs layer
skills.description: Stand up a durable-jobs layer from a reference baseline (BullMQ default = a bull-board-wired worker; Inngest = framework-nextjs-app-router shape), deps pinned EXACT (BullMQ >=5.78.1, never ^5), idempotency + retry-jitter + DLQ + BullMQ Job Schedulers (not legacy repeat) baked in. Maps to `bee scaffold`.
examples: Scaffold a new BullMQ jobs layer.
Stand up a durable-jobs layer I can build on, with idempotency and a DLQ baked in.

skills.name: Wire an inbound webhook→queue path
skills.description: Generate the RIGHT inbound webhook→queue path: verify sig on raw bytes → dedup on provider event ID (TTL >= provider retry window) → persist raw → return 202 → idempotent async worker. Inline work = duplicates by construction (S-4, O-5/O-6/O-8). Maps to `bee wire-webhook`.
examples: Wire a Stripe webhook the right way so it doesn't double-process.
Generate a webhook handler that acks fast and processes async.

skills.name: Audit a jobs layer for the 30+ pitfalls
skills.description: Run the pitfall audit over a jobs/webhook layer: at-least-once-as-exactly-once (P-X1), dedup-TTL<retry-window (P-X5), bare-exponential-no-jitter (P-X6), inline webhook (P-X7), unbounded fan-out (P-X8), side-effect-outside-step (P-I1), floating ^5 (P-B1), maxStalledCount-exempts-schedulers (P-B3). Findings keyed by P-ID. Maps to `bee audit`.
examples: Audit this jobs layer for the charge-twice class.
Check my BullMQ/Inngest code for the known pitfalls.

skills.name: Pick the right jobs tool (and name where it's WRONG)
skills.description: The decision oracle: walks the JTBD-11 tree -> recommends a tool WITH the named falls-short (O-28) + the reversibility cost (Temporal = one-way door, O-13). Profiles: serverless/cloudflare/aws/http-only/scale/complex/postgres. Maps to `bee pick-tool`.
examples: Should we use Temporal or BullMQ for mostly-short jobs?
Which queue for a serverless product?

skills.name: Search / explain the jobs brain
skills.description: BM25 ranked search over bee's expertise brain (pitfalls P-, scenarios S-, opinions O-, jobs JTBD-), or explain any ID with its detection + fix + source. Maps to `bee brain` / `bee explain`.
examples: What does bee think about dedup-TTL sizing?
How long should a Stripe dedup window be?
